hero.title: Let's talk about your project.
hero.subtitle: Leave us your details: an advisor will get back to you within one business day to understand your needs.

form.title: Contact request
form.subtitle: Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required.
form.consent: I agree that my data may be used to contact me, in accordance with the <link>privacy policy</link>.
form.errorSummary: The form contains {count, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}. Please fix the highlighted fields.
form.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
form.serverError: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
form.successTitle: Thank you, we have received your request!
form.successText: An advisor will contact you shortly at the address you provided.

sections.dataText: Name, email address and, if provided, phone number, company and message.
sections.purposeText: Your data is used solely to get back to you about your request. It is never sold or shared.
sections.retentionText: Data is kept for a maximum of 3 years after the last contact.
sections.rightsText: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, rectify and erase your data. To exercise it, simply reply to our advisor's email.
